references.title: Employer dental benefit policy (not a statute; EA 1955 s.60F pays sick-leave days, not treatment)
references.quote: Reimbursement of dental treatment the employee has already paid for; it is paid against the approved receipt and is not wages, so no statutory contribution or MTD base includes it.

description: Reimburses a dental treatment bill to the employee with net pay, at the amount entered. An employer benefit; no statute requires it.

references.title: Employer medical benefit policy (not a statute; EA 1955 s.60F(3) pays sick-leave days, not treatment): reimbursed up to RM576 per employee per calendar year for this class. The limit is the year's remainder — 576 less the class's earlier entries of the same calendar year (`earlier.calendar_year`) — and on_exceed BLOCK pays only that remainder, so a RM400 then RM800 claim pays 400 and 176, and a third claim that year pays nothing; the excess stays on the entry for HR to see against the paid line.

description: A medical bill the employer settles directly with the clinic, at the amount entered, counted against a RM1,000 yearly limit. It makes no payslip line. An employer benefit; no statute requires it.
